MedicalJobsAustralia.com     Help deliver outcomes that matter most to our Illawarra Shoalhaven community.

 

$149,408.12 - $152,392.73 per annum + 12% super & salary packaging | Permanent Full Time and Part Time vacancies | Shoalhaven Memorial Hospital (SMH) | REQ679916 | Grade: Nurse Manager Grade 2 | Applications close: 5 August 2026

Join us in shaping healthier futures. Together we can do more.

The Shoalhaven Hospital Patient Flow Manager is responsible for overall management of the site, primarily focused on patient placement both within and outside the facility.

The focus of this position is to ensure quality patient care by facilitating appropriate patient placement and bed utilisation within available capacity. The patient flow manager provides leadership to coordinate patient flow, assess critical situations and initiate contingency plans. The patient flow manager at Shoalhaven Hospital will work closely with other patient flow managers within and outside the Illawarra Shoalhaven Health District.

For more information and to view the position classification, see the Position Description here.

A little about us.

 

Shoalhaven Memorial Hospital is the main referral hospital for the Shoalhaven region, providing emergency care, medical, surgical and orthopaedic services. The hospital has an Intensive Care Unit focusing on high dependency and coronary patients, Children's Ward and Maternity Unit, as well as a purpose-built regional Cancer Care Centre.

The hospital is currently undergoing a significant $440M redevelopment that will redefine how healthcare is delivered within the Region. Once complete in mid-2026, the new seven-storey Acute Services Building and refurbishments on the current hospital site will bring a focus on career development. allowing you to grow your career, acquire new skills and advance professionally as the hospital continues to develop. There has never been a better time to join the progressive and expanding team in the Shoalhaven providing the highest standard of care to the Shoalhaven community.

To find out more about the redevelopment, visit our website or watch the flythrough of the new hospital here.

There are many benefits of living and working in the Shoalhaven. The region is home to some of Australia's most beautiful beaches, waterways and National Parks - with Jervis Bay and Kangaroo Valley only a short, 20-minute drive away - and is also host to many annual food and arts festivals and events.

Benefits of working with ISLHD.

We understand that balancing career aspirations with the demand of the everyday, as well as maintaining a healthy work-life balance, can be a challenge. To help with this, we offer a range of benefits which include:

-Allocated Days Off (ADO) - once a month take a paid day off (eligible full-time employees)

-Salary packaging- less tax and more take-home pay

-Novated leasing - lease a car and pay for all running costs out of your pre-taxed salary (eligible full-time employees)

-Fitness Passport - discounted gym membership that both you and your family can enjoy (eligible employees)

-Employee Assistance Program (EAP) - free confidential and professional assistance for staff and their families

-Career progression, professional development and secondment opportunities

Apply now by reading the Position Description, then, using our online portal, submit a resume and answer the selection criteriawithin the application. In addition, please note you must have the following essential requirements:

-Applicable vaccination requirements for a Category Arole.

-Working With Children Check (WWCC)

-Current AHPRA Registration

-Recent broad acute clinical and operational management experience within a complex health care environment

ISLHD is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.

ISLHD is dedicated to fostering a child-safe environment that respects and upholds the rights of children and young people, aligned with NSW Health's commitment to implementing the Child Safe Standards. We aim to ensure that children and young people feel safe, supported, and included in their care. All current and prospective staff are expected to prioritise the safety, welfare, and wellbeing of children and young people, actively working to protect them from harm and abuse.

 

Need more information or help applying?

-Visit the ISLHD website for application tips, to learn more about ISLHDandother important application information.

-Visit the Stepping Up website here. Stepping Up supports Aboriginal people to navigate the recruitment process and find a career or employment in NSW Health.

-Visit The Welcome Experience website here. The Welcome Experience is a free service supporting essential workers (and their families) who are considering applying for or have accepted a job in regional NSW.

-Follow us on social media: Facebook, Instagram, LinkedInand YouTube.

-For role-related queries or help applying, contact Karon Stalgis on Karon.Stalgis@health.nsw.gov.au

 At our core, RSL LifeCare provides care and services to veterans and seniors who live in our communities or are receiving support at home. You will deliver quality service creating a supportive and caring environment for our community. This role will support 2 villages in close proximity - the beautiful Bimbimbie Park (Merimbula) and Sanananda Village (Tura Beach).   This is a permanent position, 30 hours per week   Ideally you will be able to work 4 days a week with an occasional Saturday morning.   *Flexibility with weekly hours depending on the candidate's availability     This role role may involve travel across NSW. That’s Amore Cheese | Thomastown, Melbourne | Full-time | $75-80k

At That’s Amore Cheese, we don’t just make cheese — we craft moments of joy.

As a proudly Australian-owned and award-winning producer of authentic Italian-style cheeses, we supply restaurants, delis and supermarkets across Australia. With a passionate team of around 100 people, we are committed to quality, tradition and innovation in everything we do.

We are currently looking for a Dairy Product Maker to join our production team in Thomastown.

If you love food, take pride in quality workmanship and enjoy working in a fast-paced environment — this could be the role for you.

About the Role
Reporting to the Production Manager, you will be hands-on in the cheese-making process, ensuring our products meet the highest quality and food safety standards.

Your responsibilities will include:
- Prepare and process milk for cheese production in accordance with production schedules
- Monitor pasteurisation, fermentation and curd development processes
- Perform curd cutting, cooking, draining and stretching (including fresh and pasta filata styles such as mozzarella and burrata)
- Moulding, portioning and forming cheeses to specification
- Working to specification/quality standards
- Preparing and processing milk
- Mould, portion and form cheeses to specification
- Monitor moisture, texture and quality parameters throughout production
- Examining products for defects 
- Conduct quality checks and accurately record batch and production data
- Ensure compliance with HACCP, GMP and internal food safety procedures
- Compiling quality assurance reports, maintaining documentation and reporting findings
- Ongoing assessment of product quality
- Examining products for defects and grading produce
- Monitoring moisture, texture and quality parameters
- Quality checks during production
- Set up, operate and monitor dairy production machinery and equipment
- Adjust machine settings to maintain optimal performance and product consistency
- Monitoring the filling of containers and adjusting machines to maintain volume and seal quality recording information such as numbers, weight, times and dates.  
- Identify and troubleshoot minor mechanical or process issues
- Perform routine equipment inspections and basic preventative maintenance
- Report equipment faults promptly to maintenance or supervisors
- Maintain accurate production and downtime records
- Assist with weighing, packing and labelling finished products
- Packing, attaching pre-printed labels, and counting, weighing and measuring amounts.  
- Checking the cleanliness and operation of machines, equipment and containers
- Support production line operations to meet daily output targets
- Collaborate with team members to ensure smooth workflow and timely order fulfilment
- Maintain a clean and organised work environment
- Clean and sanitise equipment and work areas including sanitisation checks in accordance with food safety standards
- Adhere to workplace health and safety (WHS) policies at all times
- Participate in continuous improvement initiatives

Skills & Experience
- Experience in dairy manufacturing, food production or commercial kitchens (preferred but not essential)

- Understanding of food safety and hygiene standards

- Experience operating manufacturing or production equipment (advantageous)

- Strong attention to detail and quality focus

- Physically fit and comfortable working in a fast-paced production environment

- Strong teamwork and communication skills

- Reliable, punctual and safety-conscious

Personal Attributes
- Strong work ethic and ability to work independently.
- Team player with good communication skills.
- Flexible and adaptable to changing workloads.
- Positive attitude towards maintaining a clean and safe work environment.

Formal dairy or food technology qualifications are highly regarded but not essential, training will be provided for the right person.

Why Join That’s Amore?
Be part of a passionate, supportive team
Work with premium, award-winning products
Career growth opportunities in a growing business
Staff discounts on our delicious cheeses
A workplace that values authenticity, teamwork and excellence
If you’re ready to roll up your sleeves and help us continue bringing a slice of Italy to Australia, we’d love to hear from you.

Apply now with your resume and a short cover letter telling us why you’d be a great fit.

result.description: INNOVATIVE ENGINEERING DESIGNS PTY LTD  Innovative Engineering Designs Pty Ltd is currently seeking  an experienced Structural Engineer  to join our growing team. Work on exciting high-rise residential developments, premium commercial projects, and major civil infrastructure works across the Gold Coast and Southeast Queensland.   Benefits   Work with an established engineering consultancy specialising in innovative structural and formwork engineering solutions.  Be involved in a diverse range of commercial, residential and infrastructure projects across Australia.  Join a collaborative and supportive team that values technical excellence, innovation and continuous professional development.  Gain exposure to challenging and technically rewarding engineering projects using industry-leading design practices.  Opportunities for ongoing learning, career progression and professional growth.  Work in a positive workplace culture that encourages teamwork, knowledge sharing and continuous improvement.  Competitive remuneration package based on skills and experience.    Task & responsibilities   Design, analyse and review structural and formwork systems for commercial, residential and infrastructure projects in accordance with Australian Standards and engineering principles.  Perform structural analysis to assess the behaviour, strength, stability and serviceability of structures under static and dynamic loading conditions.  Prepare, interpret and review engineering drawings, calculations, specifications and technical documentation.  Develop practical, safe and cost-effective structural solutions that meet client requirements, project specifications and regulatory standards.  Coordinate with architects, builders, contractors and other engineering disciplines to ensure efficient project delivery.  Conduct engineering assessments of existing structures and provide recommendations for modifications, strengthening or remediation where required.  Assist in determining appropriate construction methodologies, materials and quality standards for structural and formwork systems.  Review design changes, assess their structural implications and provide timely engineering advice throughout project delivery.  Provide technical support during construction, including responding to site queries and reviewing engineering issues as they arise.  Undertake site inspections to verify construction compliance with engineering designs and identify any structural concerns.  Ensure all engineering work complies with relevant Australian Standards, building codes, workplace health and safety requirements and company quality procedures.  Prepare engineering reports and maintain accurate project records and documentation.  Contribute to continuous improvement initiatives by identifying innovative engineering solutions and promoting best practice within the business.    Qualification & experience   Bachelor's degree or higher qualification in Civil Engineering, Structural Engineering or a closely related engineering discipline.  At least one year of relevant post-qualification experience as a Structural Engineer or in a closely related role.  Demonstrated experience in structural analysis and design for commercial, residential and/or infrastructure projects.  Proficiency in structural analysis and design software, together with experience using AutoCAD and other relevant engineering applications.  Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to develop practical and cost-effective engineering solutions.  Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to prepare technical reports and liaise effectively with clients, contractors and project stakeholders.  Ability to manage multiple projects, prioritise competing deadlines and work both independently and collaboratively within a multidisciplinary team.  Commitment to workplace health and safety, quality assurance and continuous professional development.  Reliable, safety-minded, and a positive team player  Proficient in English   About Company     Innovative Engineering Designs (IED) is a specialist Australian engineering consultancy business, delivering innovative formwork design solutions to the construction industry. Based on the Gold Coast, IED works with leading builders and contractors across a diverse range of commercial, residential and infrastructure projects.    As one of the few engineering firms dedicated exclusively to formwork engineering, IED is committed to providing practical, efficient and sustainable design solutions that meet the evolving needs of modern construction.
